Stick a 'not' block in here to have the 'm' key place a zombie cub at the current players location.

You can delete all the zombie cubes locations by deleting 'all' entries in the mobs list.

Then walk around your level pressing 'm' when you are where you want a zombie cube to appear.

Next time you play, the zombies will appear!
